evidence: The stainless-steel reaction chamber was evacuated by a turbo molecular pump with a pumping speed of 50 L/s. The evacuation steps of 90 and 60 s were inserted between TBTEMN and the plasma excited humidiﬁed argon injections to remove the process gas in the reaction chamber. In all the ALD processes, the substrate temperature was maintained in a range from 26 to 30 °C.
